headline: Graham Platner ends Senate bid. And, why Nolan Wells' death captured national attention
context: Democrat Graham Platner ended his bid last night for U.S. Senate. And, prominent civil rights attorney Ben Crump has been enlisted to help get answers in the July Fourth weekend death of Nolan Wells.
